$description: Linkyo design tokens v1.0 — single source of truth for web (CSS/Tailwind/TS) and iOS (Swift/Asset Catalog). Derived from docs/BRAND_IDENTITY.md. Mode values live in $extensions['app.linkyo'] (dark, highContrast, highContrastDark; console and consoleDark for the creator dashboard, ADR 0062).

paper.$description: Light background. Warm off-white — never pure #FFF for large areas.

white.$description: Text on Linkyo Violet and danger fills; small elevated surfaces only.

teal.$description: Linkyo Teal, the brand color (founder's choice, ADR 0032). 700 and 600 are the given anchors.

350.$description: Link text on dark surfaces (≥ 4.5:1 on #1C1C1F).

400.$description: Linkyo Teal on dark backgrounds: focus rings, icons.

600.$description: The lighter band: hover, focus rings, primary in dark mode.

700.$description: Linkyo Teal. Primary actions, links, logo, brand surfaces (white text).

800.$description: Pressed state; selected text on light surfaces.

350.$description: Link text on dark surfaces (≥ 4.5:1 on #1C1C1F).

400.$description: Linkyo Violet on dark backgrounds: focus rings, icons, links on #0A0A0B.

500.$description: Linkyo Violet. Primary actions, focus rings, links, logo.

200.$description: Soft lime for large tinted panels (marketing).

400.$description: Spark. Rare accent: Live, badges, celebration. Max 5 % of any screen. Always with ink text.

night.$description: Cool near-black surfaces for dark mode (brand §4.2).

graphite.$description: Cool neutral at the hue of ink and night (OKLCH 286°, chroma ≤ 0.0083): the creator dashboard's greys (ADR 0062). Never warm, so it never drifts toward orange. The dark end is night and ink.

50.$description: Dashboard ground (light); primary and focus in the dark dashboard.

100.$description: Selected and tinted fills in the light dashboard.

400.$description: Link hover in the dark dashboard.

600.$description: Link hover in the light dashboard.

semantic.$description: Product UI roles. $value = light mode; $extensions['app.linkyo'].dark = dark mode; $extensions['app.linkyo'].console / .consoleDark = the creator dashboard, black and grey (ADR 0062; always both, never with high-contrast values). All text pairs verified ≥ 4.5:1 (see test/tokens.test.ts).

canvas-muted.$description: Soft fills and secondary regions (fields, chips, quiet cards, sidebar): a whisper of Linkyo Teal in light mode.

group.$description: Grouped lists and panels in the dashboard: one step above canvas-muted in both modes.

hover-inverse.$description: Hover overlay on inverse surfaces (toasts, tooltips).

control-knob.$description: Switch thumb: white on the teal track in both modes.

tinted.$description: Tinted buttons (the quiet partner of a primary action, as on iOS): a soft teal fill with tinted-fg text, never an outline.

tinted-hover.$description: Tinted buttons on hover and press: one step deeper.

tinted-fg.$description: Text/icons on tinted fills (≥ 4.5:1 on tinted and tinted-hover).

fg-disabled.$description: Disabled text (exempt from contrast, never the only signal).

primary.$description: Primary action fill: Linkyo Teal #00454C, one step lighter (#00565F) on dark surfaces; white labels on it.

link.$description: Links and brand-colored text. In the creator dashboard (ADR 0062) links are body coloured: weight and an icon mark them.

link-hover.$description: Link text on hover. Equals fg outside the dashboard (links turn from teal to body colour); in the dashboard, where links are body coloured, a step lighter (≥ 4.5:1).

spark.$description: Live / celebration accent. ≤ 5 % of a screen.

tint-teal.$description: Light Linkyo Teal panel behind marketing illustrations and the Pro card.

sans.$description: Product UI. Arabic glyphs fall through to IBM Plex Sans Arabic.

text.$description: Type scale (web, rem; 1rem = 16px). Display styles use tracking −3 %.

display-sm.$description: Hero headline beside a picture: two lines within half the content width.

spacing.$description: 4 px base, 8 px rhythm. Keys follow the 4 px multiplier (0_5 = 2 px).

reveal.$description: One-time entrance of a hero or section (marketing).

move.$description: Large moves: cards changing places in the hero carousel.

ambient.$description: Slow ambient loops: glow breathing, floating phones.

carousel.$description: How long each page stays in front in the hero carousel: it scrolls down its page, returns to the top, then the next one comes.

showcase.$description: A full cycle through the five templates in the hero phone.

marquee.$description: One lap of the template marquee.

toast.$description: Toast with Undo stays this long.

glide.$description: A previewed page stays on its first screen this long before it starts to scroll by itself.

spinner.$description: A loading indicator appears only when loading takes longer than this, so fast loads never flash it.

emphasized.$description: Large, confident moves that settle softly (cards changing places).

glide.$description: Long, calm moves that start and end gently (a page scrolling by itself).

exit.$description: Things leaving the screen: they speed up as they go (a sheet sliding away).

ambient.$description: Desktop ambient background behind creator pages.

desk.$description: Dashboard shows a compact live preview from here.

xl.$description: Dashboard shows sidebar + editor + live preview.

short.$description: Very short screens (a phone held sideways): at this height or less, sticky bars scroll away. Generates the short: variant (max-height).

nav-panel.$description: Section panel beside the rail; rail + panel = 248 px, the former sidebar.

work.$description: The wide canvas of creator pages (portfolio templates and every project page). Own name, same value as content.

preview-compact.$description: Compact live phone preview (desk to xl).

prose.$description: Max line length for long text.

photo.$description: Landscape tiles, and the ratio of a picture whose size is unknown.

phone.$description: A phone screen (our page captures are taken at 390 × 844).

creator.$description: Creator page system. Colors are generated per creator by src/creator (OKLCH + contrast guard); these tokens define the building blocks.

shadow.$description: Card: surface fill with a hairline border. Flat like everything in Linkyo (no shadows, ADR 0037); the key keeps its name for saved pages.

card.$description: Media cards on creator pages (list rows, tiles, featured). Follows the button shape, capped so large cards never become stadiums.

template.$description: Poster page templates: a named look (colors, fonts, buttons) plus layout options. Explicit creator choices override a template; a template overrides its base preset.

preset.$description: Theme presets: starting points, all editable. accent = seed, neutral = hue source for surfaces, tint = 0 (neutral) … 1 (strongly tinted).

swatch.$description: Extra accent colors for creator pages (the example gallery uses them; the theme engine keeps every one readable).
